divergences.old: deps frisk --source sonatype scanning the git repository's manifests itself
divergences.toil: toil ossindex vulns checks an inventory: toil deps scan output from --from <file> or stdin (toil deps scan --include-transitive | toil ossindex vulns). The --ecosystem, --direct-only and --include-dev filters apply to that inventory
divergences.why: One command does one thing against one source; the scan is its own command and the sources compose with it (docs/integrations.md, dependency analysis).

divergences.old: deps frisk --source sonatype probing OSV.dev and Artifactory, as well as OSS Index, before every run
divergences.toil: toil ossindex vulns probes OSS Index only, as before, and never contacts OSV.dev or Artifactory. tier is still "full" on every success, as it always was once OSS Index answered
divergences.why: A command talks only to the public API it names in its own name.
